name: Japanese
notes: Five courses of at least 4 credits, chosen with your undergraduate advisor.

TWO-CREDIT COURSES: one PAIR of two-credit courses (for example two conversational Japanese courses) may substitute for one 4-credit course. The two-credit courses are JPNS 114, 115, 203 and 204; the planner's 4-credit floor excludes them, so count such a pair yourself.
The summer program in Tokyo (JPNS 107 or JPNS 157) counts as either a language or a culture course.

EDUCATION ABROAD: up to one course per semester of education abroad in Japan may be applied, pre-approved by a Japanese Program advisor. TRANSFER: credit for up to one course from another institution may be applied; for language coursework you must demonstrate the matching level on the MLC Japanese placement test.

requirementGroups.label: Five Japanese language and culture courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The Japanese minor consists of a total of five courses (of at least 6.0 and/or 4.0 credits) in Japanese language and culture to be selected in consultation with your undergraduate advisor.
